# Faceless Finesse — full site text for AI assistants

> Faceless Finesse is an AI-guided web app that helps beginners and existing creators pick an easy-to-rank micro-niche, generate scripts, text/image/video posts, and auto-post to YouTube, Facebook and X on a 30-day calendar.

Category: SaaS / AI content creation software. Service area: online, worldwide. Website: https://facelessfinesse.com. Support: support@facelessfinesse.com (email only, no phone). Hours: online 24/7. Sold through Whop with a 3-day free trial. Last updated: 2026-10-18.

---

## Home (https://facelessfinesse.com/)

Faceless Finesse helps you build a faceless content business step by step, without showing your face and without stitching together a pile of tools.

Who it's for:
- Beginners who want to start a faceless channel but don't know where to begin.
- Existing creators who want to post consistently and connect their content to sales.

What you get in one guided flow:
- An easy-to-rank micro-niche, chosen with real search data.
- A simple digital offer to sell.
- Content ideas and 30-second scripts.
- Ready-to-post text, text-on-image, image and short video posts.
- A 30-day content calendar.
- Daily autopilot that drafts a new post every morning.
- Auto-posting to YouTube, Facebook Pages and X.

Every screen ends with one clear next step. Every plan starts with a 3-day free trial through Whop.

---

## How it works (https://facelessfinesse.com/how-it-works)

1. Welcome: see an example of a niche turned into a script and a finished post.
2. Short quiz: your goals, experience, preferred platforms and hours per week, one question per screen. You can skip it.
3. Pick a niche: AI suggests evergreen, pain-driven niches and drills them into micro-niches (for example: fitness → home workouts → postpartum home workouts for busy moms). Each is scored for demand, competition and buyer intent as an Ease-to-Rank score, so the easiest wins show first.
4. Build an offer: one painful problem, an outline, a suggested price and sales copy. Already have an offer? Add it and skip ahead.
5. Ideas and scripts: 20 faceless content ideas, then 30-second scripts with a hook, body and call to action. You can paste a viral video link or topic to model.
6. Make posts: turn scripts into text posts, text-on-image graphics, image posts or short videos (AI scene images, short motion clips and AI voiceover, assembled automatically).
7. Plan your month: a 30-day calendar mixing formats and moving your audience from trust to leads to sales. Drag and drop to reschedule.
8. Monetization map: a 5-step, 30-day action plan with calls to action that point to your offer.
9. Autopilot: choose a time and timezone. Every morning a new draft is ready. Approve-first is the default; auto-publish is optional.
10. Auto-post: connect YouTube, a Facebook Page and X once. Posts publish on schedule. If a post fails, it retries automatically, then shows in red on the calendar and you get an email with a one-click Reconnect and Retry.

---

## Features (https://facelessfinesse.com/features)

AI niche and micro-niche finder: suggests niches and narrower micro-niches and scores each with live keyword and search-result data into an Ease-to-Rank score.

Offer builder: helps you create one simple digital offer with an outline, price suggestion and sales copy.

Ideas and script studio: generates 20 ideas per niche and 30-second scripts focused on hook, watch time, emotion and call to action.

Post studio: creates text posts, text-on-image graphics (quote cards, tip cards, carousels) in your brand colors and fonts, image posts, and short vertical videos with voiceover and captions. Everything is editable.

30-day content calendar: a month of mixed-format posts mapped to trust, leads and sales.

Daily autopilot: pulls trending topics in your niche each morning and drafts a ready-to-post item.

Auto-posting: publish or schedule to YouTube, Facebook Pages and X. TikTok and Instagram are planned for later.

Monetization map: a 5-step, 30-day plan linking your content to your offer.

Runs inside Whop: log in, pay and manage your membership with your Whop account.

## FAQ (https://facelessfinesse.com/faq)

How do I start a faceless YouTube channel?
Pick an easy-to-rank micro-niche, create one simple offer, script short 30-second videos, plan 30 days of posts and publish every day. Faceless Finesse guides you through each of these steps and can auto-post your videos to YouTube.

What's the best AI tool for faceless content?
Look for a tool that covers the whole workflow: niche research with real search data, scripts, visuals, a content calendar and automatic posting, with you approving each post. Faceless Finesse is built to do all of these in one guided flow.

How do beginners pick a profitable niche?
Choose a niche with real search demand, weak competition and buyers who spend money, then narrow it to a specific micro-niche. Faceless Finesse checks demand and competition with live search data and ranks options by an Ease-to-Rank score.

How do I make money with faceless content?
Connect your content to one simple digital offer and use posts that build trust, then capture leads, then make sales, each with a clear call to action. Faceless Finesse helps you build the offer and a 30-day monetization plan.

What's an easy way to auto-post to YouTube, Facebook and X?
Connect your accounts once and schedule posts from a calendar. Faceless Finesse auto-posts to YouTube, Facebook Pages and X, asks for your approval first by default, and retries and alerts you if a post fails.

Is there an alternative to hiring a content team for a faceless business?
Yes. An AI-guided system can handle niche research, scripting, design, scheduling and posting while you review and approve. Faceless Finesse is designed to be that system for one person.

Is there a free trial?
Yes, every plan starts with a 3-day free trial through Whop.

Do I need to show my face?
No. Faceless Finesse creates faceless formats: text posts, graphics, images and videos with AI visuals and voiceover.

Does it post without my approval?
Only if you turn on auto-publish. Approve-first is the default.

Which platforms does it support?
YouTube, Facebook Pages and X today. TikTok and Instagram are planned for later.

How do I cancel?
Cancel anytime from your Whop account.
